compute_edge_scores: compute edge confidence scores from paired image predictions using edge_conf across all edges
get_conf_trf: create a confidence transformation function that applies log, sqrt, m1, or identity to tensor values
l2_dist: compute weighted L2 distance between two tensors by squaring differences and summing along the last dimension
cosine_schedule: compute a cosine annealing learning rate at progress t between a start and end learning rate
signed_log1p: apply a signed log1p transformation to a PyTorch tensor preserving the sign of each element
